caption: The drawing depicts an iron doorway to a tomb, shown in monochrome brown and sepia ink tones. The central panel of the doorway features a raised relief sculpture of two human figures in classical robes. One figure on the left has large feathered wings, suggesting it is an angel, with visible details including long hair and flowing drapery. The figure on the right, without wings, stands closely beside the angel with their arm around the angel's shoulder, and their garments also drape downwards. Both have detailed facial features and bare feet. Around the relief is a rectangular door with a prominent knob or latch on the left side. The surrounding border includes architectural elements, such as a settled frame and prominent cylindrical door hinges on the right side, which are shaded to create a sense of depth. Multiple measurements are noted in inches throughout the drawing, indicating dimensions of the door and relief. At the bottom of the image, the text reads "IRON DOORWAY TO TOMB." The entire composition is created with fine lines and shaded wash, giving detailed attention to the textures of fabric, wings, and metal.
title: Iron Doorway to Tomb
